// probe reads each case named on the command line, `<kind>:<path>`, with the generated C++
// readers and prints one `<reader> <verdict>` line each (TestRangeRoundTrip, CODEGEN.md §5.15):
// a probe case with lib's Parse (the text), lib's Decode (the parsed value) and app's data loader
// on the file's .data twin; an items or tags file with app's data loader.
#include <fstream>
#include <iostream>
#include <sstream>
#include <string>

#include <nlohmann/json.hpp>

#include "appc/app.gen.h"
#include "libc/lib.gen.h"

namespace {

std::string Slurp(const std::string& path) {
    std::ifstream in(path);
    std::stringstream text;
    text << in.rdbuf();
    return text.str();
}

void Report(const char* reader, bool ok, const std::string& error) {
    std::string flat = error;
    for (std::size_t at = flat.find('\n'); at != std::string::npos; at = flat.find('\n', at)) {
        flat.replace(at, 1, "\\n");
    }
    std::cout << reader << " " << (ok ? std::string("ok") : "error " + flat) << "\n";
}

void Probe(const std::string& path) {
    std::string text = Slurp(path);
    std::string error;
    Report("cpp-parse", ::lib::Probe::Parse(text, error).has_value(), error);
    error.clear();
    nlohmann::json doc = nlohmann::json::parse(text, nullptr, false);
    Report("cpp-decode", ::lib::Probe::Decode(doc, error).has_value(), error);
    error.clear();
    Report("cpp-data", ::app::LoadProbe(path + ".data", error) != nullptr, error);
}

}  // namespace

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        std::string arg = argv[i];
        std::size_t colon = arg.find(':');
        std::string kind = arg.substr(0, colon);
        std::string path = arg.substr(colon + 1);
        std::string error;
        if (kind == "probe") {
            Probe(path);
        } else if (kind == "caps") {
            Report("cpp-file", ::lib::DecodeCapsFile(Slurp(path), error).has_value(), error);
        } else if (kind == "items") {
            Report("cpp-data", ::app::Items::Load(path, error) != nullptr, error);
        } else if (kind == "tags") {
            Report("cpp-data", ::app::Tags::Load(path, error) != nullptr, error);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
